title: Show patient: explain the treatment
summary: Open Show patient, walk the patient through the picture and the options, and change the plan on the spot.

steps.title: Open the visit
steps.narration: Start the visit from Today, as usual.

steps.title: Tap Show patient
steps.narration: When you are ready to explain, tap Show patient. Turn the screen towards the patient.

steps.title: The story cards
steps.narration: The patient sees their mouth as simple cards. Tap the arrow to go to the next card.

steps.title: What we found
steps.narration: Each tooth gets its own card, with its pictures. Tap All cards to jump to any card, such as Usual options.

steps.title: Usual options
steps.narration: This tooth already has a treatment under way. Tap Other ways to treat it to compare the usual options.

steps.title: Option cards
steps.narration: The options appear as cards, each with its picture. Your own suggestion comes first.

steps.title: Open More
steps.narration: The pictures can match the patient's own teeth. Open More.

steps.title: Match the tooth colour
steps.narration: Slide the tooth colour lighter or deeper until it looks like their teeth.

steps.title: Go with this
steps.narration: If the patient prefers another option, tap Go with this. The plan changes at once.

steps.title: Undo
steps.narration: Undo stays on screen for a few seconds, in case you tapped the wrong card.

steps.title: Edit the tooth
steps.narration: To change anything else, tap Edit. The tooth opens in a side sheet, so you never leave Show patient.

steps.title: Back to the patient
steps.narration: Tap the chips you need, such as a treatment or a condition. Each one is saved at once. Then close the sheet and carry on explaining.
